faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Chennai Campus, for hiring qualified candidates for technical and instructional roles within the engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Lab Assistant/Lab Instructor-Electronics and Communication Engineering, aimed at managing and assisting academic laboratory sessions effectively.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Lab Assistant/Lab Instructor position in the Electronics and Communication Engineering department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E., B.Tech, or M.Tech degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering along with relevant practical hands-on technical skills.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants should have working experience with embedded systems, IoT boards, sensors, FPGA boards, electronic devices, function generators, DSOs, and PCB-related equipment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is completely online through the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham career portal or designated email links.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham recruitment is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidate will be at the Chennai campus of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham in the state of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q10. How can I access the official notification and website?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at https://www.amrita.edu/job/lab-assistant-lab-instructor-chennai/ and use the direct links provided in the important links section of this article.
